capabilities: Open Mermaid diagrams in a zoomable lightbox from Reading view
Zoom and pan via pinch, drag, mouse wheel, and toolbar controls
Force a white canvas so diagrams stay readable in dark mode
Optionally enable the lightbox in Live Preview editing mode
Export and import plugin settings as a JSON file
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README ends with a 'Star history' section.
intentEvidence: Open a Mermaid diagram in a zoomable lightbox on a bright white canvas.
problem: Mermaid diagrams are hard to read in dark mode and cannot be zoomed or examined closely in Reading view.
summary: Mermaid diagram viewer that opens diagrams in a zoomable, pannable lightbox with a forced white background in Reading view.
